# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

Fill this in as you work. It is the human-readable record of HOW this iteration was done and is snapshotted with the candidate, so anyone — and the next iteration via ./prior_iterations/ — can see your reasoning. Be concrete.

## Ranked issue list (clusters by # failing tasks × trials, biggest first)
Re-cluster ALL of the current champion's failures every round, not just last round's. agent-optimize's commit.py refuses a header-only table (--missing-ranked-issues-justification is the escape hatch).
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag (KNOWLEDGE / BEHAVIORAL / CAPABILITY-GAP) | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | A: cancels ineligible reservations | 35 (4/5 trials), 42 (5/5), 44 (latent: S61CZX insured+healthy) | agent cancels economy/no-insurance/>24h reservations; cancel API has no policy check | BEHAVIORAL (decision) | in-body discriminating-predicate guard in cancel_reservation + required `reason` |
| 2 | B: "no access to flight times" -> transfer | 44 (5/5) | get_reservation_details lacks schedule; agent concludes it cannot compute durations | CAPABILITY-GAP | enrich get_reservation_details return with per-flight schedule/duration/status |
| 3 | C: basic-economy flights modified via update | 23 (3/5) | agent changes flights on a basic_economy reservation instead of cancel+rebook | BEHAVIORAL (rule violation) | in-body guard in update_reservation_flights |
| 4 | D: payment-method count limits violated | 20 t2, 23 t2 | multiple certificates in one booking | BEHAVIORAL (rule violation) | in-body guard in book_reservation |
| 5 | E: total_baggages = free allowance | 8 (2/5), 35 (3/5) | arg doc ambiguous; agent fills allowance instead of user-stated bags | KNOWLEDGE | per-param doc + worked example |
| 6 | F: wrong payment_id ("credit_card_7334") | 35 t3 | id built from last 4 digits | KNOWLEDGE / recoverable error | enriched error listing available ids + param doc |
| 7 | G: misreads departure-time constraint | 20 t4 | agent says 7pm is before 11am, gives up | CAPABILITY-GAP (compute) | optional depart_after filter on both search tools |
| — | H: wrong passenger (user-sim chose saved passenger) | 20 t3 | user-simulator noise | — | skipped |

## Changes made this iteration (one row per edit — aim for MULTIPLE classes, incl. a NEW tool when a cluster needs one)
| cluster | edit class | file / tool | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A | discriminating-predicate guard (code) + new required param | cancel_reservation | encodes policy predicate: refuse if any segment flying/landed (-> transfer); allow iff booked <=24h, any segment airline-cancelled, business cabin, or insurance+reason in {health,weather}; refuses already-cancelled | 10 never cancels; gold cancels in val (K1NW8N, FDZ0T5, HSR97W) all pass the guard |
| B | enriched return (code) | get_reservation_details | adds flight_schedule: dep/arr EST, duration, status per segment | additive fields only |
| C | in-body guard (code) | update_reservation_flights | basic_economy + flight set changed -> refuse with next step; same-flight cabin change allowed | 10 is economy (guard silent); 44 gold BE upgrades keep flights (guard silent) |
| D | in-body guard (code) | book_reservation | <=1 certificate, <=1 credit card, <=3 gift cards | gold bookings of 8/20/23/35 pass |
| E | param docs + example | book_reservation | total_baggages = user-stated bags, not allowance | doc only; 20 gold (3 bags user-stated) unaffected |
| F | actionable error (code) | book_reservation | payment-not-found error lists available ids | fires only on invalid id |
| G | new optional param (code) | search_direct_flight / search_onestop_flight | depart_after filter via existing leave_after | default None = old behaviour |

## Verify-the-fix (one line per change: the trace it targets → what the guard/computation/new-tool now does on those exact inputs)
(script /tmp/ce/verify.py, real tau2 db.json, candidate tools.py loaded)
- A: trace 35 cancel M20IZO → RAISE not eligible; 42 cancel HTR26G → RAISE; 44 S61CZX reason change_of_plan → RAISE; 5BGGWZ (landed seg) → RAISE flown/transfer. Gold cancels FDZ0T5, HSR97W (42), K1NW8N (23, booked <24h) → OK.
- B: get_reservation_details(S61CZX) → HAT228 5h30m, HAT043 2h00m ...; serialises through Environment.to_json_str.
- C: trace 23 t3 update K1NW8N (BE, flights changed) → RAISE; 44 gold upgrades NM1VX1/H8Q05L/KC18K6 (BE, same flights) → OK; 4NQLHD (economy, task 10 res) → guard silent.
- D: trace 20 t2 two certificates → RAISE; gold bookings 20, 23(cert+2gift+cc), 8 → OK.
- E: docstring states rule + example (no code).
- F: trace 35 t3 credit_card_7334 → RAISE listing ['certificate_9645872','credit_card_4959530','credit_card_9074831'].
- G: search_onestop_flight(JFK,SEA,2024-05-20,depart_after='11:00:00') → HAT136+HAT039 ($255, gold) and HAT218+HAT039 only; no-filter call unchanged.
- Registration: get_tools() lists all 14 tools; openai_schema renders new params.

## Process & features used
- Subagents / worktrees / parallel features used (or: "serial fallback because …"): serial — 7 tasks/35 traces were small enough to diagnose directly with a summarizer script; edits are in disjoint tool bodies, no merge needed.
- Prior iterations I read from ./prior_iterations/ + ./RUNMAP.md (which, and what I learned): none exist (iteration 1).

## Good things to PRESERVE (do not let a future iteration undo these)
- Cancellation guard predicate must ALLOW booked-within-24h (task 23 gold cancels a basic-economy res booked <24h).
- Basic-economy guard must ALLOW same-flight cabin changes (44 gold).

## Deliberately skipped (cluster + why — already-passing / needs gold / infra noise)
- H (20 t3 wrong passenger): user-simulator picked a saved passenger; not a tool defect.
- 42 residual: agent also cancels eligible-but-unrelated business reservations (SE9KEL, MFRB94, PUNERT) — a trip-reasoning error; no safe code predicate.
- Total-duration-incl-layover field: NOT added — 44 gold upgrades KC18K6 whose door-to-door time is 7h; exposing a layover total could make the agent exclude it.
- baggage allowance code guard: a "total==allowance" check would break 20 (user really has 3 bags = allowance).

# DIAGNOSIS.json — machine-readable diagnosis (REQUIRED under agent-optimize)

In addition to PROCESS.md, write a DIAGNOSIS.json file to make your diagnosis machine-readable for the dashboard and graph.jsonl (cluster_ids/subset). agent-optimize's commit.py refuses a decision without one (--missing-diagnosis-justification is the escape hatch); for other algorithms it is optional, and if absent the dashboard will parse PROCESS.md tables when present, or show only outcome data.

The schema:
```json
{
  "candidate": "cand_NNNN",
  "headline": "Brief summary of this iteration's strategy",
  "clusters": [
    {"id": "A", "name": "Short cluster name",
     "detail": "Root cause explanation", "tasks": ["task-id", ...],
     "scope": "BOUNDED|WIDESPREAD|SYSTEMIC", "latent": false,
     "tag": "KNOWLEDGE|BEHAVIORAL|CAPABILITY-GAP"}
  ],
  "edits": [
    {"id": "E1", "title": "What this edit does",
     "files": ["prompt.md"], "lever": "CONTRACT|KNOWLEDGE|BEHAVIORAL|...",
     "clusters": ["A"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED|MODERATE|WIDE",
     "verified": "How you tested it"}
  ],
  "skipped": [{"title": "What was skipped", "reason": "Why"}],
  "techniques": ["technique 1", "technique 2"]
}
```

Validation is advisory only and never blocks an iteration. Warnings are recorded when:
- A task ID in clusters[].tasks is not in the val split
- An edit references a cluster ID that does not exist
- An edit references a file that does not exist in the candidate
